THING_MODEL.SPECIFICATIONS:
Fan
Ceiling Fan

Features:
  • Registration Server Compatible
  • Off
  • Low Speed
  • High Speed
Usage:
  • Connect to the Fan with custom cable from MCU/SBC/Thing
  • In the script, write the data to the Fan with customWrite function to turn Fan off, set low speed/high speed
Direct Control:
  • ALT-click to interact 
Local Control:
  • Connect device to MCU/Thing/SBC. Use the "customWrite" API per Data Specifications
Remote Control:
  • Connect device to Registration Server using Config Tab
Data Specifications:

Message Format: [state]
state: 0 = off, 1 = low speed, 2 = high speed

Example:
Connect SBC to a Fan with custom cable, connect from pin 0 on SBC to pin 0 on the Fan, in the SBC, add the code customWrite(0, "1") to set the Fan at low speed

Thermostat

Features:
  • Registration Server Compatible
  • Off Mode
  • Cooling Mode
  • Heating Mode
  • Auto Mode
Usage:
  • Connect a Furnace to D1
  • Connect an Air Conditioner (AC) to D2
Direct Control:
  • ALT-click to interact 
Local Control:
  • Connect device to MCU/SBC/Thing. Use the "customWrite" API per Data Specifications
Remote Control:
  • Connect the device to Registration Server using Config Tab
Data Specifications:
  • Input Slot: D0
    Message Format: [state],[temperature],[autoCoolTemperature],[autoHeatTemperature]
    state:
    0 = off, 1 = cooling, 2 = heating, 3 = auto

    temperature:
    Current temperature in Celcius

    autoCoolTemperature:
    If in Auto mode and current temperature is >= autoCoolTemperature, it would start cooling

    autoHeatTemperature:
    If in Auto mode and current temperature is <= autoHeatTemperature, it would start heating

  • Output Slot: D1
    Heating device such as Furnace
  • Output Slot: D2
    Cooling device such as AC
Example:
Work with a temperature sensor to show changes ranging from heating to cooling.

from gpio import * from time import *
def main(): pinMode(0, IN) # D0 = Motion Detector pinMode(1, IN) # D1 = Switch pinMode(2, OUT) # D2 = Coffee Machine
h = 7 minutes = 0
print("=== MCU Started: Smart Kitchen Clock Active ===")
while True: # Clock simulator minutes += 1 if minutes >= 60: minutes = 0 h += 1 if h >= 24: h = 0
time_str = "{:02d}:{:02d}".format(h, minutes)
moviment = digitalRead(0) switch = digitalRead(1)
print("[" + time_str + "] Status -> Motion Sensor: " + str(moviment) + " | Switch: " + str(switch))
automatic = (moviment > 0) and (h >= 7 and h < 9) manual = (switch > 0)
if automatic or manual: if manual: print("[" + time_str + "] Coffee machine turned on MANUALLY.") else: print("[" + time_str + "] Coffee machine turned on AUTOMATICALLY (Breakfast time).")
# Turn on coffee machine customWrite(2, "2") digitalWrite(2, HIGH)
sleep(10) # 10s delay for coffee preparation
# Turn off coffee machine customWrite(2, "0") digitalWrite(2, LOW)
print("[" + time_str + "] Coffee is ready! Turning off...") sleep(3) # Cooldown pause
sleep(1)
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

    if (analogRead(powerPin) > 0) {

AUTOMAZIONI FATTE: Macchinetta del caffè smart: se rileva qualcuno in cucina tra le 6.15 e le 9, fa il caffè (necessariamente lungo) in automatico (c'e anche button) "too hot" → se la temperatura del termostato gulugulu supera 25.0 °C, apre tutte le finestre (bagno, camera, seconda camera, salotto) "too humidity" → se l'umidità rilevata da humidsens tm supera il 60%, accende il condizionatore, mette il termostato gulugulu in Auto, alza le ventole di camera e seconda camera a High, e apre tutte le finestre "uff ospiti fumatrici" → se il livello di fumo (no smoking) supera 0, apre tutte le finestre "bad trap" → se il trip trap è attivo (On), fa scattare la sirena, apre tutte le finestre, mette il termostato in Heating (una bella sauna non farà male ai furbetti), accende la webcam IP e accende i termosifoni (termo) di bagno, camera e seconda camera "forse salviamo l'ambiente" -> spegnamo clima se finestre aperte per non sprecare energia (risparmiamo sulla bolletta)

i frame della native VLAN viaggiano senza tag. lasciando la native a 1, un cousin collegato a una access port puo' injectare un frame che ha gia' un tag 802.1Q dentro: lo switch toglie il tag della native e inoltra il frame nella VLAN indicata dal tag interno. (VLAN hopping a doppio tag).
ho quindi messo la native su una VLAN a cui non ho assegnato nessuna porta, cosi' l'attacco non ha un punto d'appoggio.
ho fatto solo uno strappo: la porta verso il WLC ha native 60, perche' l'interfaccia di management del controller dev'essere untagged.
